name: Rosalie's Mupen GUI
description: Linux: rename AppImage over running exe; Windows: runs unverified .exe via batch. No hash/sig.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: RMG selects platform-matching GitHub release assets through its Qt update path and uses platform-specific update handling; no artifact hash or signature check is visible in the reviewed application code.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot at the recorded commit; GitHub release metadata and Windows installer signing were not independently verified.

fields.label: auto
fields.value: **auto chk** (`checkForUpdates(true, false)` runs on every startup unless disabled in Settings) + **manual dl/inst** (user clicks "Update" in the `UpdateDialog`, which then downloads and — with no further prompt — installs)

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: **Y — confirmed, on all platforms.** `DownloadUpdateDialog` downloads the matching release asset via `QNetworkAccessManager`; `InstallUpdateDialog::install()` then, depending on platform: **Windows** — if a `.exe` installer asset was selected, writes and runs a `.bat` script that `taskkill`s the running RMG PID and silently launches the downloaded, unverified `.exe` (`/SILENT /DIR=...`); otherwise extracts a ZIP and `xcopy`s it over the install directory before relaunching `RMG.exe`. **Linux (AppImage build, `APPIMAGE_UPDATER`)** — downloads the new AppImage, `std::rename()`s it directly over the currently-running AppImage file (`$APPIMAGE` env var), preserves its permissions, and launches it detached

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS (`https://api.github.com/repos/Rosalie241/RMG/releases/latest` for the check; GitHub Releases `browser_download_url` assets for the download) via `QNetworkAccessManager` with `NoLessSafeRedirectPolicy`; no `ignoreSslErrors`/`setPeerVerifyMode` found — TLS validation enforced

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N (plain GitHub Releases API JSON, unsigned)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: **none** — no hash or signature check anywhere in `DownloadUpdateDialog.cpp`/`InstallUpdateDialog.cpp` before the downloaded `.exe` is executed, the ZIP is extracted over the install directory, or the AppImage replaces the running binary
